storylines.description: The video presents a collection of facts about the history of life on Earth, focusing on the increase in complexity of organisms over time and the occurrence of mass extinctions. It also explores two hypotheses explaining potential causes for mass extinctions: Intrinsic and Extrinsic.

content_metadata.title: Video Analysis: Evolution and Mass Extinction
